question: Operator step with a free MyTomTom account (no card): record every field of the registration form after 'No account? Create one' on the sign-in page, make one keyed geocode and one keyed route and record their HTTP statuses, then submit an asynchronous Batch Search of a few geocode items and read the MyTomTom Analytics page to see whether the items decrement the Geocoding pool (20K) or the Search API pool (2.5K).
why: The pricing FAQ says batch endpoints are billed per underlying request, not per call, but only an account shows which monthly free pool each item uses; the registration form fields after the first screen are behind a sign-up. The Matrix Routing page also says that API is charged in transactions computed from origins and destinations, and the pricing page states no unit for its 2.5K free monthly amount.
